'''Kre Nol-Shod''' was a fast-draw killer who served as [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Henris Octavian]]'s [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]. Nol-Shod was always by the governor's side.<ref name="Game" />
